summary.text: Terry Williams is the incumbent state senator for the Rutland District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election as a Republican and Democratic candidate.
A retired Army officer and former deputy game warden from Poultney, he has served in the Senate since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Williams was born in Rutland and lives in Poultney, and he graduated from Poultney High School.

He served in the Vermont Army National Guard from 1973 to 1979, was a commissioned armor officer from 1979 to 2004, and earned an associate degree from New Hampshire Technical College and a B.A. from Regents College.

His career experience includes working as an automotive technician and as Vermont's state deputy game warden, and he served as vice chairman of the Poultney Selectboard and on the Rutland Regional Planning Commission.
